name: Fourteen days of unpaid leave: the threshold is reached, no insurance
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: 22 working days, 14 of them unpaid leave, so 8 paid (paidDaysCenti 800).
Insurance: uncovered working days = 22 - 8 = 14, which is 'this many or more' against the seeded threshold of 14 — the month carries no compulsory insurance.
This is the boundary case: one day fewer (case 08) and the full contribution is due.
PIT: 10,909,091 is below the personal deduction, so no tax. Net = 10,909,091.
